title: Eiffel Tower Shut Down Following Employee Strike Over Alleged Religious Discrimination
snippet: Paris's iconic landmark unexpectedly closed to tourists after staff walked off the job following allegations that a female worker was removed from her post to accommodate a visiting religious group.
content:
PARIS — Visitors to the Eiffel Tower were met with locked gates on Tuesday after staff members staged a sudden walkout, shutting down operations at one of the world's most famous landmarks. The labor action follows controversial allegations that a female employee was forcibly removed from her post to satisfy the demands of a visiting religious group.

Labor Union Protests Workplace Incident

Union representatives representing the monument's workforce expressed outrage over the incident, alleging that site management compromised employee rights and workplace standards to accommodate private requests. According to union officials, the female worker was reassigned after members of an incoming religious delegation voiced objections to her presence.

The strike has caused widespread disruption for thousands of tourists who had lined up to ascend the landmark. The operating company behind the Eiffel Tower, SETE, acknowledged the operational stoppage and stated that discussions are ongoing with union leaders to resolve the dispute and safely reopen the site to the public.
